desc: 整箱量贩婴儿纸尿裤套图，湖青配奶油黄，干爽防漏卖点全用空白格承载

name: 湖青奶油黄量贩纸尿裤款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：整包直立居中，干净合规拿下第一眼的囤货装认知。
一秒讲清第一利益：把尿裤展开悬浮在色块上，顶部留出空白主张横幅位。
放大夜半渗漏、反复换洗的具象麻烦，让买家在暗光里认出自家场景。
晨间换尿裤的真实代入：只出手臂与小腿，用身份无感的亲肤画面建立向往。
用内层织纹与压点的微距质感证明干爽亲肤，替代表述性主张。
整夜干爽的使用情境收进夜灯剪影里，用背影与小手完成情绪代入。
拆开平铺解释腰贴、立体围与芯体三处结构，用空白标注位消除疑虑。
保留双栏同框对照结构，让干爽差异靠画面自证，主张位一律留白。
穿在身上的贴合特写证明不勒不挤，用局部躯干完成无身份上身演示。
替买家解答该选哪一档：保留左表右货的对照版式，表格单元全部留白。
降低到货风险预期：展示未印刷的外箱与封箱形态，让量贩装可被想象。
收口促单：主包与两件连带小包组成囤货组合，空白胶囊位承接行动号召。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio sweeps alternating a #FBF8F3 paper field and a #2F938D lake-teal field, with cream muslin textile as the only soft furnishing; info screens use blank bands and blank label plates instead of rendered copy

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm reassuring bulk-pack baby-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of paper white #FBF8F3, lake teal #2F938D, butter cream #F0DFA8 and ink teal #1F4B50; neutral balanced studio temperature; soft diffused key from the upper left with bounce fill and gentle true contact shadows; seamless studio sweeps with cream muslin textile as the only furnishing; modern geometric sans-serif in one family only with headline bands kept empty; thin single-weight line icons and empty badge outlines in #1F4B50; stable straight-on or slight 3/4 pack angle with fixed scale; infants shown only as neck-down crops, backs of head, small hands or feet; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks or award seals.
noDrift: no brand marks, award seals, ratings or readable on-image copy

style.surfaceSystem: matte paper panels #FBF8F3 and #F0DFA8, rumpled cream muslin, quilted cloth #E7DCCB, plain unprinted kraft board for the outer carton
